ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels (approx. 70-80% of surface) vs low-intensity black pixels (20-30%) concentrated on trailing edges and streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located contiguous high-intensity white region spanning both lobes. High-contrast black perimeter mapping along the superior trailing edges. Cluster of low-intensity dark splotches and vertical streaks concentrated on the mid-to-lower quadrant of the right lobe (viewer's perspective).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations on the right lobe trailing edge; deeper, high-amplitude irregular indentations on the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe follows a convex outer curve tapering to a distal point; left lobe sweep is more linear and abruptly jagged.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentration of approximately 6-8 circular high-contrast white/tan pixel clusters located on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned vertical linear streaks (rake marks) breaking the white pigment on the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches/material loss on the left lobe trailing edge; parasitic/barnacle colonization clusters on the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark hook-shaped pigment pattern near the lower right waterline intersection.
